meta.note: Texture paths are relative to assets/minecraft/textures/ and have no extension (.png). Animated textures (see animated_textures) are vertical strips: use the first square frame.

banner.note: Bedrock `banner` is one base item with the colour in aux data; white_banner used as the stand-in.

bed.note: Bedrock `bed` is one base item with the colour in aux data; white_bed used as the stand-in (the site lists 16 colour variants).

light_block_0.note: Java `light` is one item with a level property; all 16 Bedrock ids share it.

lodestone_compass.note: Java uses the same compass item with a lodestone component; the default compass model is shown.

banner_pattern.note: Bedrock has one generic banner_pattern item; Java has one per pattern. creeper_banner_pattern used as the stand-in.

cut_red_sandstone_stairs.note: Does not exist in Java: stairs shape built with the textures of cut_red_sandstone_slab.

cut_sandstone_stairs.note: Does not exist in Java: stairs shape built with the textures of cut_sandstone_slab.
